weighting: one count for each complete allowed state
local expansion: Choose an even subset at each knot. Its coefficient is one for the empty subset and -1/(2^(a-1)-1) for every nonempty even subset of an a-place knot. A term survives when the selections have odd total occurrence exactly at the observed distinctions. Divide the sum by the corresponding sum with no observed distinctions.
check scope: The three archived ring means and the parity count; targeted larger rings, many-place knots with relays and two kinds of starts with rings. No census or growth run.
quartet selection: Exploratory choice. Four-distinction readings were grouped by their six pair means up to ordering, and compared by their four-sign means. The cases here are selected witnesses, with the order fixed in the code before their direct recount. They supply no frequency weighting.
